text:
Incident Bot: <@ryan> paged: Canary anomaly: increased hallucinations and tokenization mismatch for model 'rdw-bert-quant-v2' in eu-west-1. severity: P1
Ryan (oncall): acked. I'm looking.
Jane S: seeing a spike in unparseable tokens in edge logs, sample: "Ġ▁�" / huge latency on 1% of requests
Sanjay K: can we verify weights id? logs show model artifact tag `rdw-bert-v2:quant-202603` but routing table points to `rdw-bert-v2:quant-202501` for some shards
Lena O (ops): how many customers affected?
Ali P (product): support reported 3 customers with degraded responses (EU). No data exfil, mainly bad completions and timeouts.
Ryan (oncall): isolating: turning on kill-switch for canary via `/api/v1/flags/set canary-eu rdw-bert-quant=false` — running now
deploy-bot: command accepted. Feature flag flip queued. rollback endpoint: POST /rollouts/abort
Jane S: flipping flag now... 
Ryan (oncall): flag flipped. Canary routing now 0% to quant variant. Confirming traffic shift.
Sanjay K: traffic shift looks good, error-rate back to baseline in 30s. But there are lingering pods still serving stale weights; starting remote kill on node pool eu-canary-2
Lena O (ops): running: `kubectl drain eu-canary-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` and `rdw-cli service restart rdw-serving --node-pool eu-canary-2`
Jane S: restarted, logs show model reload success and tokenizer mapping refreshed. Sample outputs look normal now.
Ryan (oncall): contacting support: @Ali P please notify affected customers that we've cut traffic to canary variant and are investigating.
Ali P (product): notifying customers: "We're aware of degraded responses for some EU customers. We've disabled the canary model variant and are investigating. We'll follow up with timeline and mitigation steps."
Sanjay K: preliminary triage: root cause appears to be a packaging script that replaced tokenizer config for quantized build with an older tokenizer-v1 mapping. Weight artifact itself OK, but tokenizer/encoding mismatch produced wrong IDs -> hallucinations and tokenization exceptions. Also routing rules had a stale alias mapping causing a small % of requests to hit old shard set.
Jane S: adding monitoring: new alert `tokenizer_mismatch_rate` created and set to 0.1% threshold. Postmortem checklist: include build validation step to verify tokenizer hash vs weights, add gating in rollout agent to verify routing alias consistency.
Lena O (ops): recommend a short hold window on future canaries in eu until gating is in place. Also request emergency rollback hotfix to ensure quant builds verify tokenizer file presence before promotion.
Ryan (oncall): oncall handoff: @Sanjay you'll own triage until 10:00 UTC; @Jane you'll own stabilization and patch verification; @Lena will lead ops rollback; @Ali will handle customer comms. I'll write incident header and escalate to eng-ml for root cause fix.
Sanjay K: noted. I will capture failing artifacts and upload to runbook.
deploy-bot: created incident ticket INC-3622345678 and runbook stub.
Incident Bot: Pager closed by Ryan (oncall) — mitigation complete. Severity remains P1 until root cause fixed.
Ali P (product): sending update to customers now. ETA for permanent fix: 24-48h with hotpatch lanes.
Ryan (oncall): postmortem owners assigned. Closing thread when postmortem draft uploaded.
Jane S: I pushed a CI check to validate tokenizer hash vs model manifest. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/rdw/quant-builds/pull/123
Sanjay K: archived artifact samples and logs to S3: s3://rdw-incident-logs/3622345678/samples.tar.gz
Lena O (ops): ops follow-up: create playbook step for immediate flag flip and pool-drain for canary anomalies.
Ryan (oncall): Thanks team. Good containment. Will open follow-up meeting invite.
